title: Coefficient square on comparison images of ordinary supported boundaries
statement: Let $N>0$, finite commutative $R,S$ killed by $N$, $\varphi:R\to S$, and an effective Cartier immersion $i:D\hookrightarrow Z$ with $N$ invertible on $Z$ be given. Let $k_R,k_S$ be ordinary degree-two Ext classes satisfying SupportedKummerBoundary [lem-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer]. Let $\eta:R_D\to\operatorname{Res}_\varphi S_D$ and $\theta:R_Z(1)\to\operatorname{Res}_\varphi S_Z(1)$ be pro-etale maps with the constant and comparison-root generator formulas of [def-sfb-geo-cartier-interface]. Write $e_R,e_S$ for the supported-source comparisons [lem-sfb-geo-cartier-source-comparison]. Then $\operatorname{mk}_0(e_R\,i_*\eta\,\operatorname{Res}_\varphi(e_S^{-1}))\circ\operatorname{Res}_\varphi(\nu_S^*k_S)=(\nu_R^*k_R)\circ\operatorname{mk}_0(\theta)$ in degree-two Ext. This is only a square on ordinary comparison images; it asserts no existence or universal property of coefficient units.

proof.text: Identify the extension in each relative boundary witness with the unique integral pole boundary. This rewrites SupportedKummerBoundary as its supported integral scalar-adjunct equation. Apply exact comparison inverse image, the supported-source isomorphism, and the canonical coefficient-forgetting square. Naturality of short exact sequence Ext classes identifies the positive Kummer boundary after comparison.

proof.text: Compose the supported integral-to-residue derived unit with the normalized coefficient unit from ULift(Z/N) to R. Apply the existing Cartier-scalar-unit conversion lemma to obtain its exact-functor DerivedUnit form. Transport composite coefficient forgetting through its canonical identity isomorphism. The supported integral generator scalar identity identifies the composite map with the specified integral generator. Its induced map on degree-two Ext is injective for every target.

proof.text: The supplied eta preserves the supported integral generator, while theta preserves the pro-etale root map by their normalization formulas. The latter identity preserves the positive Kummer Ext class. Apply the integral-generator Ext injection to the scalar square of inverse-source-comparison classes. Exact-functor composition and Yoneda associativity reduce it to the two scalar-adjunct equations and these generator identities.

proof.text: Precompose the resulting square with the R source comparison. Reassociate degree-zero Yoneda products and cancel both source isomorphisms with their inverses. An abstract categorical helper proves this cancellation without unfolding concrete sheaf definitions. The result is precisely the stated coefficient square on comparison images.

theorem geoCartier_boundary_scalar_square
    (R S : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Finite R] [Finite S]
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hR : (N : R) = 0) (hS : (N : S) = 0)
    (φ : R →+* S) {D Z : Scheme.{u}} (i : D ⟶ Z) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (hI : i.ker.IsInvertible) (hZ : IsUnit (N : Γ(Z, ⊤)))
    (kR : Ext ((Etale.lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R) i).obj
      (Etale.ordinaryFiniteConstant R D)) (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine Z N R hR) 2)
    (kS : Ext ((Etale.lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} S) i).obj
      (Etale.ordinaryFiniteConstant S D)) (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine Z N S hS) 2)
    (hkR : Etale.SupportedKummerBoundary R N hR i hI hZ kR)
    (hkS : Etale.SupportedKummerBoundary S N hS i hI hZ kS)
    (η : geoCartierConstant R D ⟶
        (Sheaf.restrictScalars (Scheme.ProEt.topology D) φ).obj (geoCartierConstant S D))
    (θ : geoCartierLine R N hR Z ⟶
        (Sheaf.restrictScalars (Scheme.ProEt.topology Z) φ).obj (geoCartierLine S N hS Z))
    (hnorm :
    (∀ (W : D.ProEtᵒᵖ) (a : R),
      η.hom.app W ((toSheafify (Scheme.ProEt.topology D)
        ((Functor.const D.ProEtᵒᵖ).obj (ModuleCat.of R R))).app W a) =
      (toSheafify (Scheme.ProEt.topology D)
        ((Functor.const D.ProEtᵒᵖ).obj (ModuleCat.of S S))).app W (φ a)) ∧
    (∀ (W : Z.Etaleᵒᵖ) (a : R) (z : (Z.rootsOfUnitySheaf N).obj.obj W),
      θ.hom.app ((Scheme.toProEt Z).op.obj W)
        (((comparisonAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R) Z).unit.app
          (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine Z N R hR)).hom.app W
            (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateOneGenerator R N Z hR W a z)) =
      ((comparisonAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} S) Z).unit.app
        (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine Z N S hS)).hom.app W
          (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateOneGenerator S N Z hS W (φ a) z))) :
    (Ext.mk₀ (geoCartierSourceComparison R i ≫
      (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R) i).map η ≫
      (Sheaf.restrictScalars (Scheme.ProEt.topology Z) φ).map
        (asIso (geoCartierSourceComparison S i)).inv)).comp
      ((kS.mapExactFunctor (comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} S) Z)).mapExactFunctor
        (Sheaf.restrictScalars (Scheme.ProEt.topology Z) φ)) (zero_add 2) =
    (kR.mapExactFunctor (comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R) Z)).comp
      (Ext.mk₀ θ) (add_zero 2)
